=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19792-19794 (also 28056, 28286; scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:99; .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:508, 803-810, 859-872) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The poller gates PERSIST_ORCH_CONTEXT_ENABLED through _is_truthy, which accepts 1/true/yes/on, but persist_orchestrator.py enabled() accepts only `.strip().lower() == "true"` and the orchestrate.yml decomposer gates require the exact string "true".
  WHY: With the switch set to `1`, `yes` or `on`, the poller writes persist_judge_added and persist_merged_pr and starts Python at both wave-issue creation sites, while since-note returns reason=switch_off and the decomposer steps are skipped, so the feature is silently half on. With `TRUE ` the mismatch runs the other way. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini, minimax) vs NIT (sonnet, luna, glm); the highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9720, 9756, 31948, 31984 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Static analysis flags a possible indentation or syntax error in the jq commands that add the persist_judge_added field in create_judge_fixup_issues_from_verdict() and the wave new-issue block.
  WHY: If the jq syntax is invalid, the orchestrator state update fails during the poll tick and the orchestrator stalls. Note: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this claim and rejected it as a false positive.
- tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py:test_every_test_file_runs_in_a_workflow | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The CI test that checks every test file runs in a workflow is failing after tests/test_persist_orchestrator.py was added.
  WHY: The failure blocks CI and breaks the suite's coverage contract. Note: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash report that the test is now wired in ci.yml (ci.yml:674) and that there is no current evidence of the failure.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:28284-28292 (backward-scan paths 27586-27600, 27638-27647) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new persist_merged_pr write runs only for the current wave's WAVE_STATUS items, and the two prior-wave backward-scan paths set status="merged" without writing persist_merged_pr.
  WHY: For the rest of the project, every since-note renders items merged through the backward scan as "merged, PR unknown", even though `_bws_pr` and `PW_PR` already hold the PR number at the call site.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "When PERSIST_ORCH_CONTEXT_ENABLED, record persist_merged_pr … on the wave issue entry" so later-wave since-notes show earlier merged items as "merged as PR N"
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, prior-wave backward-scan `.status = "merged"` writes at lines 27588-27590 (ai:merged path) and 27644-27646 (ai:ready-to-merge path)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk touches either backward-scan write, which set only status="merged"; the only persist_merged_pr writer (28284-28301) iterates WAVE_STATUS for `.waves[$WAVE_IDX]` only; PW_PR and _bws_pr are in scope but go unused; persist_orchestrator.py:186-187 renders ", merged, PR unknown" when the field is missing.
- requirement: "Stay inside the files the plan lists for P7" / modify ONLY files granted in the files_touched list
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml and docs/INVENTORY.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR changes .github/workflows/ci.yml (adds tests/test_persist_orchestrator.py) and docs/INVENTORY.md (adds the scripts/persist_orchestrator.py entry), and neither path is in the files_touched grant; the autofix editor acknowledged the scope expansion.
- requirement: "When scripts/evidence_pack.py is present in the support checkout, append its pack for the paths named in the plan file referenced by the description"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml, step "Build persistence context (P7)", `if [ -f scripts/evidence_pack.py ]` block
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The block also requires PERSIST_EVIDENCE_PACK_ENABLED, which defaults to 'false' (orchestrate.yml line 75), and evidence_pack.py enabled() returns false at that default, so with only PERSIST_ORCH_CONTEXT_ENABLED=true no evidence pack is appended.
- requirement: P7 "With the variable off, the PR must be production-safe and change no existing behaviour" and the agents-fragment switch-off contract (byte-identical off)
  expected_change_site: scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:99 (`enabled()`) and .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:803, 859
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Both gates use a literal `== "true"` check while the poller uses _is_truthy; the switch-off tests exercise None, "false", "0", "no" and "TRUE " but never yes, on or 1.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (persist_orch_judge_added_json, about line 19792; gates at about 28056, 28286, persist_orch_since_note) vs scripts/persist_orchestrator.py enabled() (about line 99) and .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml decomposer gates | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The poller (_is_truthy: 1/true/yes/on) and the helper and workflow (exact "true") parse the same switch differently, and the mismatch now covers state writes too.
  WHY: With `1`, `yes` or `on`, the poller writes persist_merged_pr and persist_judge_added and starts python3, while since-note returns switch_off and the decomposer is skipped, so the feature is half on. With "TRUE " it runs the other way.
- TASK_GAP | confidence=3 | severity=NIT
  Requirement: Record persist_merged_pr on each merged wave entry (plan P7 / agents fragment "State field").
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, prior-wave backward-scan writes at lines 27588-27590 and 27644-27646.
  Evidence of absence: The only writer is the current-wave loop (lines 28284-28301), so prior-wave items render "merged, PR unknown"; the fix is about 3 gated lines at 27646 reusing `PW_PR`.
- Rejected pass-1 items: the gemini jq/slop-scan BLOCKER (false positive; points at python heredocs at 9665/9777), the test_ci_wires_every_test_file BLOCKER (now wired), the ci.yml/INVENTORY.md scope MAJOR (required by CI guards), and the evidence-pack TASK_GAP (documented conservative choice). (4 related items)
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml "Build persistence context (P7)": prefix the `persist_plan=... plan-path` call with `timeout 30`. scripts/persist_orchestrator.py enabled(): accept `in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")`. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
